scale_rule: uniform viewport_width/1024; preserve aspect ratio; safe-area top offset applied to BOTH states

home.input: TextureButton; transparent padding is decorative, hit rect at least face rect

stats.input: TextureButton; transparent padding is decorative, hit rect at least face rect

play.input: TextureButton; transparent padding is decorative, hit rect at least face rect

player_name.rule: 1 line vertically centered; long names up to 2 lines, 28px line height; then ellipsis. No uppercase transform.

medal.rule: official trophy PNG; preserve transparent margins and aspect; no Bronze label; empty trophy hides image without moving separators

level.rule: Native Label: min2digits; size36 for2digits, size28 for3digits; available x354..410 before separator418; reflow explicit for4+digits.

progress.rule: track in base_before; fill drawn dynamically, never bake 62%; clamp invalid to0; rounded ends radius=min(6,fill_width/2); percentage and fill same data

elapsed.rule: monotonic active elapsed milliseconds; display centiseconds with floor; do not add frame delta; freeze at outcome; do not cap elapsed at99 minutes; use HH:MM:SS above1hour (same8characters)
